mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tb_feed WHERE feed_no = #{feedNo} )
SELECT COUNT(feed_no) FROM tb_feed WHERE feed_visible_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(feed_no) FROM tb_feed WHERE feed_visible_yn = 'Y' AND user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT feed_list.feed_no, feed_list.feed_title, feed_list.feed_created, feed_list.user_nickname, feed_list.user_image_url, feed_list.feed_file_path, ( SELECT COUNT(fl.feed_no) FROM tb_feed_like fl WHERE fl.feed_no = feed_list.feed_no ) AS feed_like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(fc.feed_no) FROM tb_feed_comment fc WHERE fc.feed_no = feed_list.feed_no AND fc.feed_comment_delete_yn = 'N' ) AS feed_comment_count FROM ( SELECT f.feed_no, f.feed_title, f.feed_created, u.user_nickname, u.user_image_url, ff.feed_file_path FROM tb_feed f LEFT JOIN tb_feed_file ff ON f.feed_no = ff.feed_no AND ff.feed_file_sort_order = 1 INNER JOIN tb_user u ON f.user_no = u.user_no WHERE f.feed_visible_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY f.feed_created DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{startRowNum} ) feed_list

SELECT feed_list.feed_no, feed_list.feed_title, feed_list.feed_created, feed_list.user_nickname, feed_list.user_image_url, feed_list.feed_file_path, ( SELECT COUNT(fl.feed_no) FROM tb_feed_like fl WHERE fl.feed_no = feed_list.feed_no ) AS feed_like_count FROM ( SELECT u.user_image_url, u.user_nickname, f.feed_no, f.feed_title, ff.feed_file_path, f.feed_created FROM tb_feed f LEFT JOIN tb_feed_file ff ON f.feed_no = ff.feed_no AND ff.feed_file_sort_order = 1 INNER JOIN tb_user u ON f.user_no = u.user_no WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY f.feed_created DESC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.startRowNum} ) feed_list

SELECT f.feed_no, f.feed_title, f.feed_content, f.feed_created, u.user_no, u.user_nickname, u.user_image_url FROM tb_feed f INNER JOIN tb_user u ON f.user_no = u.user_no WHERE f.feed_no = #{feedNo} AND u.user_delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_feed ( user_no, feed_title, feed_content, feed_visible_yn, feed_like_visible_yn, feed_created ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{feedTitle}, #{feedContent}, #{feedVisibleYn}, #{feedLikeVisibleYn}, #{feedCreated} )
